_comment: The skiac functions the canvas tier wraps, grouped by handle domain.
Not all 204 declarations are wanted: skottie, pdf, svg-document, gpu and
drawable families are later phases, and anything the generator cannot
classify from the header alone is listed in `manual` instead of here so
it gets a hand-written wrapper in sg_skia_extra.cpp.
`domains` maps a skiac struct name to the handle-table domain that owns
it. A function whose first parameter is `<struct>*` becomes a handle
param; a function RETURNING `<struct>*` allocates into that domain.
_manual_comment: Hand-written in shim/sg_skia_extra.cpp. Each entry says WHY the
generator refuses it, so the list is auditable rather than a dumping
ground. If a reason stops being true, the function moves to `generate`.

manual.skiac_bitmap_get_shader: skiac_transform by value; also needs repeat-mode mapping
manual.skiac_canvas_get_total_transform: returns skiac_transform by value (no struct returns in FFI)
manual.skiac_canvas_get_line_metrics_or_draw_te: 26 params incl. struct out-param and two strings
manual.skiac_canvas_draw_image: bitmap+bool is_canvas discriminator; wrapped as drawImage overloads
manual.skiac_canvas_put_image_data: mutable pixel pointer + many params; bytes param needs a copy
manual.skiac_surface_read_pixels_rect: bulk readback; goes through the readback protocol
manual.skiac_paint_set_shader: CRASHES on NULL: the impl calls shader->ref() unconditionally, and handle 0 (= clear the shader) is the common case
manual.skiac_paint_set_path_effect: CRASHES on NULL: same unconditional ->ref(); clearing the dash is the common case
